text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll answer them...! I will, I will! I'm going to win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's me—
The star of the show could never be anyone else!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Unable to eat, ...unfulfilled, into my empty and bitterly cold body...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The heat... The heat is――!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can still run.
Still, still, still... even faster!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even more—!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaargh!!

For the first time, she—who had always
stoically and quietly strived to fulfill her self-imposed mission—
revealed a glimpse of—
It was a heat blazing with brilliant radiance.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Taking a brilliant victory in the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho, is Narita Top Road!! Answering all expectations, she crosses the finish line first!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
~~~~~ All right!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!!
Thank you so much for your support...!!
(Waaaaaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (—It's still... burning hot.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (So painful it felt like my throat and chest were burning to cinders.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Is this the same heat I felt during my debut?
...Your heat?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (That's... right, isn't it? Tell me—)

Though she conceded 1st place to Narita Top Road,
Admire Vega still achieved a splendid result in the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown.

Her appetite, which had been a concern, seemed to be recovering.
It looked like we could smoothly continue preparations for the next big stage, the Japanese Derby.
As for her, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: ...Ayabe, we're done with today's menu, you know?
...Ayabe, we're done with today's menu, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah— Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
......Not yet, not yet.
Ayabe-san and Opera O-chan
are definitely going to be in even better shape...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Derby too, I will take it!
I'll claim it without fail and become a Double Crown Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...By the Derby...
I wonder how fast she'll become?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What kind of race... will be next—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading out. Good work today.
Little by little, slowly but surely, within her—

I feel like something akin to
a "rivalry" is beginning to sprout.

"Dedicate victory to her little sister."
That was an immensely important goal to her.
However, if in the midst of running, Admire Vega herself can also find rivals in the race and discover the joy of competing—
choice_data_list: (That's a really wonderful thing, isn't it?)

text_block_list.text:
On the way home one day,
I suddenly look up at the sky and wonder.
Come to think of it, where's Admire Vega—
choice_data_list: I wonder if she's been able to go stargazing lately?
I wonder if she's been able to go stargazing lately?

text_block_list.text:
Under the cloudy spring skies that continued for a while after that,
training for the Nippon Derby began—
